name: unsafe fn from_raw_handle (handle : RawHandle) -> Self
rule: When `from_raw_handle` is used to consume ownership of `handle`, the returned object takes responsibility for closing the handle when the object goes out of scope.
api: trait FromRawHandle  : { unsafe fn from_raw_handle (handle : std::os::windows::io::raw::RawHandle) -> Self }
expression: No equivalent DSL expression exists: the grammar cannot express future handle-closing responsibility when the returned object goes out of scope.
